courses.title: INTRODUCTORY CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: High school Chemistry at the advanced level.

courses.title: INTRODUCTORY CHEMISTRY I
courses.prereqText: High School Chemistry (Grade 11 Advanced Level or equivalent) or permission of the Dean, and registration in a Preliminary Year program at Brescia University College.
courses.antireqText: Ontario High School SCH4U or equivalent, Chemistry 0010, any university-level Chemistry course.

courses.title: INTRODUCTORY CHEMISTRY II
courses.prereqText: Registration in a Preliminary Year program.
courses.antireqText: Ontario High School SCH4U or equivalent, Chemistry 0010, any university-level Chemistry course.

courses.title: DISCOVERING CHEMICAL STRUCTURE
courses.prereqText: Grade 12U Chemistry (SCH4U) or equivalent.

courses.title: DISCOVERING CHEMICAL ENERGETICS
courses.prereqText: Grade 12U Chemistry (SCH4U) or equivalent. Grade 12U Advanced Functions (MHF4U) or Calculus & Vectors (MCV4U), or Mathematics 0110A/B or 0105A/B, is strongly recommended.

courses.title: ORGANIC AND BIOLOGICAL CHEMISTRY FOR FOOD SCIENCE
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 1301A/B and Chemistry 1302A/B.

courses.title: CHEMISTRY OF THE ENVIRONMENT
courses.prereqText: (Chemistry 1301A/B and Chemistry 1302A/B) or (Chemistry 1301A/B and Integrated Science 1001X).

courses.title: INORGANIC ELEMENTS IN LIFE
courses.prereqText: (Chemistry 1301A/B and Chemistry 1302A/B) or (Chemistry 1301A/B and Integrated Science 1001X). (Grade 12U Biology or a Year 1 University Biology course is highly recommended as preparation for this course.)

courses.title: ORGANIC CHEMISTRY FOR LIFE SCIENCES
courses.prereqText: (Chemistry 1301A/B and Chemistry 1302A/B) or (Chemistry 1301A/B and Integrated Science 1001X).

courses.title: PHYSICAL CHEMISTRY FOR LIFE SCIENCES
courses.prereqText: (Chemistry 1301A/B and Chemistry 1302A/B) or (Chemistry 1301A/B and Integrated Science 1001X); 0.5 course from: Calculus 1000A/B or Calculus 1500A/B, and 0.5 course from: Applied Mathematics 1201A/B, Calculus 1301A/B, Calculus 1501A/B, Mathematics 1225A/B, Mathematics 1229A/B, Mathematics 1600A/B.
courses.antireqText: Chemistry 2274A, the former Chemistry 2374A, the former Chemistry 2384B.

courses.title: ORGANIC CHEMISTRY OF BIOLOGICAL MOLECULES
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 2213A/B or Chemistry 2283G.

courses.title: STRUCTURE AND BONDING IN INORGANIC CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: (Chemistry 1301A/B and Chemistry 1302A/B with a minimum mark of 60% in each) or (Chemistry 1301A/B and Integrated Science 1001X with a minimum mark of 60% in each).

courses.title: INTRODUCTORY ANALYTICAL CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: (Chemistry 1301A/B and Chemistry 1302A/B) or (Chemistry 1301A/B and Integrated Science 1001X).

courses.title: ORGANIC CHEMISTRY I : STRUCTURE AND SPECTROSCOPY
courses.prereqText: (Chemistry 1301A/B and Chemistry 1302A/B with a minimum mark of 60% in each) or (Chemistry 1301A/B and Integrated Science 1001X with a minimum mark of 60% in each).

courses.title: PHYSICAL CHEMISTRY I: THERMODYNAMICS AND KINETICS
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 1301A/B, Chemistry 1302A/B, 0.5 course from Calculus 1000 A/B, Calculus 1500A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1412A/B, and any other 0.5 course at the 1000-level from Calculus, Applied Mathematics, Mathematics, or Numerical and Mathematical Methods. Integrated Science 1001X may be used as a substitute for the combination of Chemistry 1302A/B and Calculus 1301A/B.

courses.title: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY OF THE MAIN GROUP ELEMENTS
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 2271A or (Chemistry 2211A/B with a minimum mark of 80%).

courses.title: ORGANIC CHEMISTRY II: MECHANISMS AND REACTIVITY
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 2273A or (Chemistry 2213A/B with a minimum mark of 60%).

courses.title: PHYSICAL CHEMISTRY II: QUANTUM THEORY
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 1301A/B, Chemistry 1302A/B, 0.5 course from Calculus 1000 A/B, Calculus 1500A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1412A/B, and any other 0.5 course at the 1000-level from Calculus, Applied Mathematics, Mathematics, or Numerical and Mathematical Methods. Integrated Science 1001X may be used as a substitute for the combination of Chemistry 1302A/B and Calculus 1301A/B.
courses.antireqText: Chemistry 2214A/B, the former Chemistry 3374A/B, the former Chemistry 2384B.

courses.title: ORGANIC AND INORGANIC STRUCTURE ELUCIDATION
courses.prereqText: (Chemistry 2213A/B or Chemistry 2273A) and (Chemistry 2211A/B or Chemistry 2271A).

courses.title: COMPUTER METHODS IN CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 1301A/B, Chemistry 1302A/B, and any 1.0 courses at the 1000 level or higher from Calculus, Applied Mathematics or Mathematics, with no mark less than 60%. Integrated Science 1001X with a minimum mark of 60% may be used as a substitute for Chemistry 1302A/B and Calculus 1301A/B.

courses.title: POLYMER CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: Either (Chemistry 2273A and Chemistry 2283G) or Chemistry 2213A/B, and either (Chemistry 2214A/B or Chemistry 2274A or the former Chemistry 2384B).

courses.title: INDUSTRIAL CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: Either (Chemistry 2273A and Chemistry 2283G) or Chemistry 2213A/B, and one of (Chemistry 2214A/B, Chemistry 2274A, the former Chemistry 2384B).

courses.title: RADIATION, NUCLEAR, AND RADIOPHARMACEUTICAL CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 1301A/B and (Chemistry 1302A/B or Integrated Science 1001X).

courses.title: MATERIALS CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 2214A/B or Chemistry 2274A or the former Chemistry 2384B.

courses.title: INSTRUMENTAL ANALYTICAL CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 2272F.

courses.title: ORGANIC CHEMISTRY III: REACTIONS AND STRATEGIES FOR SYNTHESIS
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 2283G.

courses.title: BIOINORGANIC CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 3371F.

courses.title: MEDICINAL CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 2213A/B or Chemistry 2283G.

courses.title: CURRENT TOPICS IN CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: Permission of the Department.

courses.title: APPLICATIONS OF SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY AND CHEMICAL GENETICS IN MEDICINE
courses.prereqText: Either (Biochemistry 3381A and Biochemistry 3382A) or (Biochemistry 2280A and one of Chemistry 3393A/B or Chemistry 4493A/B).

courses.title: MOLECULAR STRUCTURE AND SIMULATION
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 2284B or the former Chemistry 3374A/B or Physics 3200A/B.
courses.antireqText: The former Chemistry 4444A/B, the former Chemistry 4474A/B.

courses.title: TRANSITION METALS AND CATALYSIS
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 3371F.

courses.title: ADVANCED ANALYTICAL CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 3372F/G.

courses.title: MODERN CHEMICAL SYNTHESIS
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 3373F.

courses.title: SOLID-STATE INORGANIC CHEMISTRY AND MATERIALS
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 3371F.

courses.title: CHEMICAL RESEARCH DISCOVERY AND SCIENTIFIC COMMUNICATION
courses.prereqText: Completion of any 1.0 courses from (Chemistry 3320A/B, Chemistry 3371F, Chemistry 3372F/G, Chemistry 3373F) and registration in (Honours) Specialization in Chemistry or in Honours Specialization in Biochemistry and Chemistry. Students registered in other modules require special permission of the Department.

courses.title: CHEMISTRY OF BIOLOGICAL MACROMOLECULES
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 2283G or Chemistry 2223B. Chemistry 3373F is advantageous, but not required.

courses.title: BIOPHYSICAL CHEMISTRY
courses.prereqText: Chemistry 2274A or the former Chemistry 2374A.
